program.name: Skill Ladder
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Bodyweight skill progressions: archer push-ups, shrimp squats, hollow rocks. Harder versions arrive at Level II.
program.about: Bodyweight skills step by step: archer push-ups, shrimp squats, hollow rocks and more. Two days alternate in straight sets, one for push and legs and one for legs and core. Level II brings harder versions and Level III slows them down. For getting stronger with nothing but your body and patience.
